neighbours.label: Advice about a website or online presence at the point where the device or platform it must suit comes next ("your site is optimized⟦ for⟧ [mobile]", "easy to use⟦ on⟧ a phone"); also outdated-browser notices
fire: Before you launch, check that your website is optimized for mobile screens.
Customers will leave if your online shop is not optimized for small devices.
A good blog theme is fast, clean and optimized for every browser.
Our web designers make sure each landing page is optimized for mobile users.
Your company homepage should load quickly and be optimized for tablets.
Test whether the checkout page of your site is optimized for touch screens.
Search engines now rank a site higher when it is optimized for mobile.
Every page of the new online catalogue has been optimized for phones.
quiet: Before you plant, check that your greenhouse is optimized for winter light.
Runners will tire if their training plan is not optimized for long distances.
A good bread oven is hot, dry and optimized for even baking.
Our engineers make sure each turbine blade is optimized for low wind.
Your delivery route should be short and optimized for morning traffic.
Test whether the seat of your bicycle is adjusted for long rides.
Farmers now earn more when a field is optimized for two harvests.
Every shelf of the new warehouse has been arranged for heavy boxes.

notes: Card: no single token; web and URL contexts ('Search', ' web', quotes before URLs), top prose examples 'everything you do online⟦ is⟧ optimized for mobile', 'using⟦ an⟧ outdated browser'; output promotes ' mobile'. Probes: 'site … is optimized for speed' 0.75, 'online is optimized for mobile' 0.71, 'outdated browser' 0.43, 'store is easy to use on a phone' 0.39; 'recipe is optimized for high altitude' 0.01, quoted 'index.html' 0.01, startswith('http://') 0.23, 'outdated map' 0.33 (a leak).
